artworks.title: Foot Combat with Spears
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures in combat. The drawing depicts two figures wearing medieval armor and helmets, engaged in a spear fight. One figure has a decorated helmet with a plume, and both wear armor with intricate designs, including plated skirts and metal boots. They are grappling with one another, holding a long spear-like weapon, suggesting a dynamic action scene. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Foot Combat with Spears and Tartsche Shields

The figures are positioned facing each other, seemingly locked in combat. The armor is shaded with tones suggesting polished metal, and includes elements such as plumed helmets and skirted armors. On the ground beneath them, there are two pieces resembling shields pointing in opposing directions. The background is kept minimalistic to focus attention on the duo.

artworks.title: Foot Combat with Spears and Buckler Shields

Two shields and spears are on the ground in a symmetrical arrangement. The background is plain, emphasizing the armored warriors.

artworks.title: Foot Combat with Falchions
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures engaged in combat. The drawing features two figures clad in historical armor engaged in swordplay. Each figure wields a curved sword and sports intricate suits of armor with distinguishing features. The armor is adorned with feather-like ornamentation, particularly noticeable on the taller figure, whose helmet has a large plume. The second figure is dressed in similarly detailed armor with a tunic-like element that resembles scales or feathers. The depiction is flat, using soft, muted colors and outlines to render depth and detail. The piece suggests an illustration style typical of historical manuscripts, capturing a stylized depiction of a duel-like scenario.
